to get
faster!

reading it
makes me want to break into a
full-speed dash!

proceed to read it.

text_block_list.text: Oh? Ohhh! You want to use me as an example?! YOU SURE CAN!

text_block_list.text:
Practice makes perfect, and you can't
have
perfect without Bakushin! Come,
feast your eyes
on my mighty Bakushin!
